verdict.rationale: Replit's marketing says apps can be enhanced with '100+ integrations' including Stripe, so payment integration from the builder is claimed. Built-in hosting, database and auth imply a server side, but server-side functions are never documented as a feature, and email is not mentioned. The Stripe MCP servers give the Agent context to work with, not app integrations, so they add no credit here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of adding server-side functions or endpoints, any evidence of email integration, in-depth first-party docs on wiring payment integrations into an app, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add server-side functions and third-party integrations like payments and email from the builder

citations.quote: Enhance your apps with AI and 100+ integrations. Connect to OpenAI, Stripe, Google Workspace, and more in minutes.
